title: Named-launch waitlist with withdrawal

source.title: Build a waitlist for your next launch
source.original_goal: Build a waitlist for your next launch
source.demand_evidence: Catalogue presence only; popularity and conversion are unmeasured.

native.inputs_text: launch_name, launch_purpose, consent_text containing YES and STOP, membership_attribute.
native.messages_text: "Join the waitlist for {launch_name}, for {launch_purpose}? {consent_text}" Persist joined after this run's YES; STOP persists withdrawn before any handoff. Before YES keep unset; on restart preserve existing state.
native.end_stop: Actual attribute readback joined/withdrawn, isolated to this launch; S retains membership. No automatic mailings or external list claim.

use_when: People request a named launch waitlist by comment and give fresh purpose-specific YES consent.
prerequisites: Have launch name/purpose, YES/STOP copy and a unique membership attribute; inventory all names and preserve existing membership.
exclude_when: Do not choose when external list enrollment or automatic mailings are required. STOP must persist withdrawn before handoff.
Do not configure when required lifecycle operations are unavailable on the actual host.

inputs.name: campaign

inputs.description: Language for the exact approved messages.

inputs.name: initial_text

inputs.description: Exact approved team reply; native handoff needs separate readback.

inputs.name: keyword

inputs.name: public_text

inputs.name: launch_name
inputs.description: Coach-supplied launch name, preserved without invented claims.

inputs.name: launch_purpose
inputs.description: Exact purpose of membership for this named launch only; no existing email-list subscription or automatic follow-ups.

inputs.name: consent_text
inputs.description: Exact purpose-specific consent text containing YES and STOP, localized where appropriate.

inputs.name: membership_attribute
inputs.description: Unique campaign-specific attribute; inventory full namespace before preparation.

messages.text: "Join the waitlist for {launch_name}, for {launch_purpose}? {consent_text}" Persist joined after this run's YES; STOP persists withdrawn before any handoff. Before YES keep unset; on restart preserve existing state.
Understood. I will not continue this campaign.
Our team will handle your request.

steps.action: Actual matching keyword comment on the selected post.
Send the exact approved first message. Deliver any promised value now.
Stated outcome only. No inferred booking, registration, purchase, verified follow or verified share.
Persist joined in the campaign attribute only after fresh explicit YES for this launch.
Persist withdrawn on STOP BEFORE any handoff. Preserve other launch state.
End this campaign on refusal. Do not restart from a keyword in the refusal.
Send nothing for silence or external clicks; enforce current delivery windows.
Same-run repeat does not restart intake, resend a bonus or duplicate capture. Ambiguous late replies need clarification.
Use native team handoff on person request, unresolved facts or approved handoff criteria. Text alone is not handoff proof.

lifecycle.return: Use this conversation journal and fresh native readback. No cross-chat state or user settings transfer. If the journal is missing, read-only reconciliation only.
lifecycle.stop: Apply S from native-policy.md: safe owned disable; exact campaign additions only; preserve concurrent changes and inheritance. Restore dormant Send only after original OFF DM is OFF. Read back every stop; live silence is separate.
lifecycle.restart: Fresh source and consent, same verified ownership. Waitlist membership stays joined/withdrawn; no old consent reuse.
